items.title: OpenAssets brings markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as DA Registry implementation partner
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 6:12 PM ET)
- **OpenAssets brings markets-in-a-box tokenization platform to Canton as DA Registry implementation partner** — OpenAssets will make its platform, combining tokenized asset issuance, settlement, compliance, asset management and distribution in one stack, available to institutions on Canton, serving as an implementation partner for DA Registry, Digital Asset's tokenization engine; DA Registry adds allowlist, blocklist and transfer-approval controls connected to external KYC and AML providers, and has already enabled more than 30 issuers and tokenization platforms on Canton (PR Newswire)
- **LayerZero becomes first interoperability protocol live on Canton, linking tokenized assets to 165-plus chains** — The integration lets regulated firms route tokenized assets across more than 165 public blockchains while retaining compliance controls, with LayerZero reporting its ecosystem represents over $100 billion in value (BitRss)
- **Digital Asset raises $355 million led by a16z crypto to accelerate Canton adoption** — The round drew participation from BNP Paribas, Broadridge, Citadel Securities, HSBC, S&P Global and Tradeweb among others, will fund expanded Canton offerings and deeper engagement with developers and financial institutions, and starts a partnership giving Digital Asset access to a16z crypto's company-building, policy and research expertise (Tradeweb)
- **Canton records over $155 million in Q3 fees, CertiK says** — The network burns Canton Coin to pay for services, while its recorded daily fee pace was below the 30-day snapshot reported in June, so fee income reflects institutional usage that does not reveal the underlying transactions (The Defiant)

Network: CC $0.089059 | Market cap $3.57B | 24h volume $9.04M; milestone: Digital Asset reports working with more than 700 ecosystem participants as Canton scales as core infrastructure for global finance (MarketCapOf for market data; Tradeweb for the milestone)

items.title: Kaiko joins Canton Foundation collateral workstream to bring trusted pricing to tokenized collateral
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 5:42 PM ET)
- **Kaiko joins Canton Foundation collateral workstream to bring trusted pricing to tokenized collateral** — The market data provider has joined the Canton Foundation's Collateral Sub-Committee and leads its Workstream 2 on Collateral Mobility and Interoperability, bringing Bloomberg evaluated pricing and NCFX regulated FX benchmarks onchain through its Data On-Ramp so central counterparties and market infrastructures can move tokenized Treasuries, repo and cash from pilots to accepted collateral and margin (Kaiko)
- **Hecto launches $NEOPRIME, the first tokenized pre-IPO exposure token on Canton** — Issued by Neoprime on Hecto's infrastructure as a tokenized debenture under British Virgin Islands law, $NEOPRIME gives backed exposure to a basket of late-stage private companies including Anduril, Figure AI, Shield AI and Crusoe, with Erebor as the first completed position; eligibility requires a pre-IPO company valued at $1 billion or more with independent pricing data available (The Block)
- **Canton Summit 2026 recap puts more than 650 firms connected to the network** — Digital Asset's recap of Canton Summit 2026 in New York, with Goldman Sachs, JP Morgan, Nasdaq, HSBC, DTCC and Franklin Templeton among those discussing Canton as rails for global financial markets, notes CEO Yuval Rooz's figure of more than 650 firms connected to the network in two years (Canton Network)
- **Canton approves on-chain enforcement of Featured App and Super Validator locking under CIP-0127** — Super Validators approved CIP-0127, which puts Featured App and Super Validator locking commitments under on-chain enforcement through governance locks of at least 10,000 CC from Splice 0.10.0, so lock-up rules are enforced by the network itself rather than by agreement alone; wallet providers have been asked to expand memo fields to 1,000 characters to encode the lock data (Canton Network Docs)

Network: CC $0.089 | Market cap $3.56B | 24h volume $9.30M | Supply 40.04B CC; milestone: Canton recorded $9 trillion in monthly transaction volume and 81.2 million transactions in Q1 2026, with more than 780 active institutional participants (Kriptometre for market data; Kaiko for the volume milestone)

items.title: Cancore raises $7.2 million seed round to connect Canton assets with public-chain liquidity
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 5:12 PM ET)
- **Cancore raises $7.2 million seed round to connect Canton assets with public-chain liquidity** — The Canton-native platform, live on mainnet since April 2026 as a validator and Featured App, closed the round with Paper Ventures, dao5, ArkStream Capital, X Ventures, MH Ventures and Proof of Talk; as of October 1 it had processed more than $53.2 million in lifetime volume across more than 84,000 trades and generated over $538,000 in protocol revenue, and will use the capital to expand to additional networks and liquidity sources (The Defiant)
- **Three Canton apps lose Featured App status over free-traffic abuse** — The Tokenomics Committee, acting on the Featured App Accountability Committee's recommendation, is revoking Featured App status from Grofty Wallet, Yapper Agent and Ibex for abusing free traffic; the revocations now go to Super Validators for on-chain approval, signalling that reward privileges are being actively policed (CC Space)
- **Nasdaq and Send awarded MainNet validator node allocations** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group granted new MainNet validator allocations, including one to Nasdaq, Inc. and three to Send, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Derivnex records the first over-the-counter swap on Canton** — DRW and Marex entered a total return swap on the iBoxx USD Liquid Investment Grade Index on October 13, recorded as the first OTC swap on the network (Datawallet)

Network: CC $0.08933 | Market cap $3.58B | 24h volume $13.37M | Supply 40.04B CC; milestone: Canton's validator count rose from 849 in March 2026 to more than 1,500 by early November (CoinCodex for market data; Datawallet for the validator milestone)

items.title: Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App on Canton
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 4:12 PM ET)
- **Tokenomics Committee approves Stable Coin (SBC) as a Featured App on Canton** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee approved Stable Coin Inc.'s SBC application for Featured App status, which now goes to Super Validators for on-chain approval; the same notice confirms an additional Super Validator weight release for Canton Strategic Holdings under the Digital Asset Treasury programme (CC Space)
- **EDX Markets launches CBTC spot trading, bringing Bitcoin-backed assets to Canton institutions** — EDX Markets partnered with BitSafe to launch spot trading of CBTC, BitSafe's Bitcoin-backed asset on Canton backed 1:1 by Bitcoin, in its first availability on a centralized exchange; Granite River Trading supports liquidity, with CBTC/USD perpetuals planned in the coming weeks and Canton Coin planned as eligible collateral (Morningstar)
- **Canton builds out its South Korea presence through Shinhan, Hanwha and LG CNS** — Shinhan Financial Group has cooperation and strategic investment links with the Canton Foundation, including Shinhan Asset Management approved as a Super Validator, Hanwha Investment & Securities has partnered with Digital Asset and invested in the company, and LG CNS is exploring Canton-based services and infrastructure (Bitrue)
- **Tokenomics Committee pauses Wintip's Featured App status after flagged activity** — The Global Synchronizer Foundation's Tokenomics Committee voted to pause Featured App status for Wintip (Winsnip) on MainNet after on-chain activity was flagged for review by the Accountability Committee; Featured App status boosts the rewards an application earns, so the pause materially changes its economics (CC Space)

items.title: Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 3:42 PM ET)
- **Upflam payments and wallet platform opens to everyone on Canton** — Upflam has dropped its invite-only access: anyone can now sign up, create a Canton wallet and take payments through payment links, invoices, donation pages, embeddable buttons, recurring AutoPay and a WooCommerce plugin, with a 0.1% fee on incoming payments (CC Space)
- **First trades of tokenized U.S. equity under SEC Innovation Exemption executed on Canton** — Shares of Canton Strategic Holdings (NASDAQ: CNTN) traded on November 4 on TSV, the permissioned venue for tokenized NMS stocks on Canton, with Five North as seller, DRW Cumberland as buyer and Flowdesk as liquidity provider; Fairmint, the SEC-registered transfer agent, recorded the shares and the trades settled atomically, the first of their kind under the SEC's September 17 Innovation Exemption (Morningstar)
- **Wells Fargo among organizations awarded MainNet validator allocations** — The Canton Foundation Tokenomics Working Group awarded additional MainNet validator node allocations, including three to Wells Fargo alongside Visoty, Cartumi, Winsnip, Winnode and Otoclick, issued in line with current network capacity and health assessments (CC Space)
- **Canton Foundation launches Community Research Grants with up to 50,000 CC per month** — The Foundation has launched Canton Community Research Grants, with up to 50,000 CC per month available beginning in November 2026 at the Foundation's discretion for original research and educational content (CoinStats)

items.title: DTCC plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:42 PM ET)
- **DTCC plans to connect its Tokenization Service to Solana in the second half of 2027** — The service launched on Canton and DTCC's private network on October 28, so Canton remains its first live venue; the announcement signals a future multi-network strategy rather than a move away from Canton (CoinMarketCap)
- **Blockdaemon faces losing 4.0 escrowed Super Validator weight after its milestones expire** — Blockdaemon's adoption milestones under CIP-94 expired without being met, so the Foundation has proposed stripping the 4.0 escrowed reward weight held via MPCH in the first visible application of the Super Validator Accountability Framework, with voting running until November 17 (CC Space)
- **Rome Protocol launches Ostia, a zero-knowledge EVM chain settling on Canton** — Ostia is live on Canton DevNet as an Ethereum-compatible chain whose blocks are proved with zero-knowledge proofs and settled in a single Canton transaction, with a bridge that moves Canton Coin and ERC-20 tokens between the two sides (CC Space)
- **Digital Asset and the American Idea Foundation select Canton for a three-state RISE benefits pilot** — The pilot is planned for Q1 2027 pending federal approval, with Canton coordinating payment rules while limiting access to recipients' sensitive information; locations and participating programs have not been disclosed (CoinMarketCap)

items.title: Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 2:12 PM ET)
- **Canton Foundation backs RedStone pricing tool with 15.8 million Canton Coin** — The Foundation approved almost 15.8 million CC, worth about $1.55 million, to fund RedStone's open-source Canton Access and Privacy Standard (CAPS) tool, letting institutions value transactions from a shared reference price without revealing their agreed settlement amounts; initial pricing covers tokenized funds, private-market assets and structured products under the Apache 2.0 license (Cointelegraph)
- **Uber completes 24/7 treasury pilot on Canton with HSBC, Franklin Templeton, Tradeweb and Fireblocks** — Uber used HSBC Tokenized Deposits to buy Franklin Templeton tokenized money market fund shares on Tradeweb through delivery-versus-payment transactions on Canton via Fireblocks, and liquidated part of the holding over a weekend while continuing to earn yield throughout the investment lifecycle (HSBC)
- **Societe Generale accepts $10 million in tokenized Treasuries as collateral on Canton** — The bank's Prime Services & Clearing division accepted the DTCC-tokenized Treasuries as eligible collateral, reflecting them in its existing back-office and collateral systems, and intends to develop support for recurring collateral movements and explore onchain repo financing (Societe Generale)
- **Circle reports 379.9 million Canton Coin held at September 30** — Circle's quarterly filing shows 379,921,930 CC with a fair value of about $48.0 million at September 30, 2026, up in quantity from 367,760,063 CC held at December 31, 2025 (Circle Form 10-Q)

items.title: Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 1:42 PM ET)
- **Nomura Group and BOOSTRY approved for Canton Super Validator participation under CIP-0130** — The November 10 vote passed with 11 in favour and two non-votes, giving the pair one shared arrangement to earn up to 10 reward weight through verified milestones tied to regulated customer access, institutional settlement and collateral integration (CantonNews)
- **OpenZeppelin Daml library and four reference designs clear Canton Dev Fund vote** — The security firm's open-source Daml contracts library and reference designs for a privacy-preserving DEX, a lending protocol, cross-chain stablecoin payments and a fourth design were approved, giving Canton builders vetted, reusable building blocks (CC Space)
- **SEC staff view Canton Coin as a digital commodity in November 3 no-action letter** — Division of Corporation Finance staff said they would not recommend enforcement over programmatic minting of CC by Super Validators, Validators and app providers as described; the letter is a staff position only and does not address secondary-market trading (Unchained)
- **CIP-0129 universal burn timeline points to private synchronizers in Q1 2027** — The first phase would apply universal fee burning to private synchronizers, described as ambitious rather than a firm deadline, with volume-based pricing estimated for Q3 2027 (CoinMarketCap)

items.title: Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives
items.body:
Canton Signal Feed (Nov 12, 2026 · 10:33 AM ET)
- **Canton roadmap leads with tokenized stocks, then repo and derivatives** — Digital Asset CEO Yuval Rooz set out the sequence in an X Space: tokenized equities first, following the first trades under the SEC's Innovation Exemption, then repo trading, derivatives and private assets (BSCN)
- **Progmat signs with Digital Asset to tokenize Japanese government bonds on Canton** — The MOU builds tokenized JGBs (tJGB) with live pilot testing this month by a working group of more than 68 institutions, including MUFG, targeting 24/7 on-chain repo settlement (Genfinity)
- **DTCC Tokenization Service is live on Canton, covering Treasuries, equities and ETFs** — The service launched October 28 with Morgan Stanley reported as an early user; DTCC also co-chairs Canton's governance alongside Euroclear (Cryptensive)
